<thought>Search for a retrosynthetic template that disconnects the target by breaking an aryl halide bond and forming a C‑C double bond, which corresponds to a Heck‑type coupling of an aryl halide (e.g., bromobenzene) with a vinyl ester bearing a trimethylsilyl‑substituted cyclopropyl group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["aryl halide"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
